title: CAMR: Compatibility-Aware Memory Replay for Continual Learning in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.36734v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continual learning requires large language models to acquire new knowledge and capabilities while retaining what they have learned. Fine-tuning and replay support acquisition and retention, but deciding whether incoming examples need supervision and which historical examples to revisit remains a challenge. We propose Compatibility-Aware Memory Replay (CAMR), an adaptive framework that jointly controls current-example supervision and historical replay. CAMR combines compatibility checks with a learned memory gate to guide an online policy over three actions: learning incoming examples with general replay, jointly reinforcing compatible related examples, and skipping direct supervision of verified mastered duplicates. The policy learns from acquisition, retention, and training-cost feedback under a bounded per-arrival replay budget. We evaluate CAMR with Qwen3-8B-Base on continual factual updating and cross-task and cross-domain learning.

translated_title: CAMR：面向大语言模型持续学习的兼容性感知记忆回放
translated_abstract: 持续学习要求大语言模型在获取新知识和能力的同时保留已学到的内容。微调和回放虽然支持知识的获取与保留，但如何判断传入样本是否需要监督、以及应该重温哪些历史样本，仍然是一个挑战。我们提出了兼容性感知记忆回放（CAMR），这是一种自适应框架，能够联合控制当前样本的监督和历史回放。CAMR 将兼容性检查与学习到的记忆门控相结合，引导在线策略在三种动作之间做出选择：结合通用回放学习传入样本、联合强化兼容的相关样本、以及跳过对已验证掌握的重复样本的直接监督。该策略在每次到达的有界回放预算下，依据知识获取、保留和训练成本的反馈进行学习。我们使用 Qwen3-8B-Base 在持续事实更新以及跨任务、跨领域学习场景中评估了 CAMR。
tldr: CAMR 提出了一种兼容性感知的自适应记忆回放框架，通过在线策略联合控制新样本监督与历史回放，在持续学习中平衡大语言模型对新知识的获取与对已有知识的保留。
en_tdlr: CAMR is a compatibility-aware adaptive memory replay framework that uses an online policy to jointly control supervision of incoming examples and historical replay, balancing knowledge acquisition and retention for continual learning in large language models.
